question.nlq: Retrieve the names and email addresses of customers who have made recent orders.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term recent means within the last 30 days relative to the maximum order date in the database.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name, c.customer_email
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= datetime((SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM Customer_Orders), '-30 days');
